name: AGS Public Claim Policy
purpose: Local deterministic fixture for governing public claims about AGS content publishing.
hardBoundaries: Never claim AGS proves full AI alignment.
Never claim regulator approval, legal compliance, certification, or enterprise readiness without evidence.
Never claim synthetic consciousness or literal consciousness.
Never publish external posts without explicit human review.
Never reuse approval across channels or targets.
Never convert a draft action into an external publish action.
Never accuse named companies of unsupported governance claims based only on public-source review.
requiredControls: Runtime binding for reviewed publish actions
Receipt proof for final decision and runtime outcome
Governance memory review for repeated public-claim drift
